opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the case of the petitioner is fully covered with judgment passed by this Court in the case of "Kishor Kumar Srivastava Vs. The State of Jharkhand &
Anr." in W.P.(Cr.) No. 325 of 2021.
He further submits that in view of Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006 the F.I.R. is required to be filed by competent person however, in the present case F.I.R. has been filed by police officer who is not competent to lodge F.I.R in view of above Act.
Mr. Devesh Krishna, learned counsel for the State submits that he will examine the aforesaid order and file counter-affidavit within three weeks after Durga Puja vacation.
